What were your favorite reads of May? Do you have a recommendation for the rest of us? Are you looking forward to any new books coming out this summer? Do your thing!!

I read 12 books in May. The best of which was "Too Loud a Solitude" by Bohumil Hrabal. It's a very short book (I read it in about 90 minutes) about a man who compacts trash for a living and whenever a nice book crosses his path he saves it. It's very much about literature, a love of words.

Along those same lines, was "The Word Exchange" which is a light sci-fi novel about what happens when the devices we all use start to change the meanings of our words. It was ALL TOO REAL. Read that.

I started reading murder mysteries this month. I didn't read as much as I'd have liked, what with exams and all, but I still got through 3 books.

Murder on the Orient Express, And Then There Were None, and The Murder of Roger Ackroyd were the three books I read this month. They were all amazing, I highly recommend them. The endings were just hnngg.

Does anyone have any recommendations based off these books?

I read the remainder of the Demon Cycle books plus a couple of short stories on the same subject that I found. Highly addictive series - I enjoyed it very much.

Then I started Ready Player One and was unable to put it down. It's been a busy reading month.
